sovietAnime.metadataDescription: A Soviet anime-inspired guide to Comrade Sovia's music adaptations, character design, visual archive, lyrics, and creative world.
sovietAnime.intro: Comrade Sovia is a Soviet anime-inspired music and visual archive: familiar melodies, fictional bureaucracy, character-driven artwork, and videos arranged as if they came from another republic of pop culture.

sections.title: Music Reconstruction
sections.text: The sound side begins with familiar songs and rebuilds them through Soviet-style rhythm, chorus, language, and archive logic.

sections.title: Anime Character Direction
sections.text: The visual side treats Sovia Rabocheva as an anime character with uniforms, posters, thumbnails, and staged documents that hold the world together.

sections.title: Creative Archive
sections.text: Lyrics, release pages, image materials, community links, and experiment rooms are gathered here so the project can be explored from one official site.
